text:
elaine: Quick sync — follow-ups from last night's KV-cache routing outage. Need to lock owners, ETA, and concrete test additions (regression, prompt sets, load, chaos drill).

mira: TL;DR: cascade from route fallback + cold-KV evictions caused 3x p95 token latency for ~12m. Postmortem has draft action items but we need explicit test coverage and cadence.

toni: I can own a regression harness for routing fallback scenarios. Suggest adding a dedicated test matrix that flips cache hit/miss and route-down conditions.

ash: I'll take ownership of the prompt/regression sets that caught hallucinations under degraded latency. Will create prompt pack and link to evals. ETA 2w.

ryan: I'll add a load test scenario that mimics the customer burst pattern (10k rps -> 2k sustained over 15m). Will add to k6 scripts and CI.

elaine: Action items summary so we can put into GH and Ops board:
- ASH: prompt-regression pack + target exact prompts from incident logs (#4123). ETA 2w.
- TONI: routing-fallback regression harness (CI job: `ci/regression/routing-fallback`). ETA 1w.
- RYAN: load test scenario + baseline numbers, include KV miss heavy profile. ETA 9 days.
- MIRA: update postmortem with clear acceptance criteria for each test and add to weekly incident-evals cadence. ETA 3d.

mira: For acceptance criteria, propose: regression pass rate >= 99% on prompt pack, p95 token latency <= 200ms on baseline infra, and no silent fallback triggers.

toni: Agree. Also propose a synthetic chaos drill that kills the primary router and KV host for 90s while ramping traffic by 2x. Schedule quarterly.

ash: Example prompt pack entry (from logs):
```
{"prompt_id":"inc-2026-03-22-01","input":"Summarize the policy changes in plain English","expected_contains":["policy change","effective date"]}
```
I'll format into CSV and add to `redwood/evals/prompt_packs/incident-2026-03-22.csv`.

ryan: k6 snippet for KV-miss profile:
```js
export default function() {
  http.post('/v1/generate', payload, { headers });
  sleep(0.05); // 20 rps per VU
}
```
I'll open PR `redwood/perf#834` with graphs and baseline.

elaine: Recurring pattern notes for PMs: this is the 2nd outage in 6 months where prefix/KV eviction + routing misconfig combined. Need a postmortem theme: "KV cache stability + observability" to make cross-team fixes.

toni: On ownership: I'll create GH issue and tag interested parties. Draft name: `regression: routing-fallback-harness` -> assign to me, reviewers @elaine @ash.

ash: I'll attach the prompt pack to the incident postmortem and add an eval job `ci/evals/prompt-regression` that runs on PRs for runtime changes.

devops-bot: Reminder set — chaos drill scheduled for 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC. Participants: @engineers, @sre.

elaine: Nice. Final ask: owners, please drop PR links in this thread when created. I'll consolidate into the remediation board and set a follow-up sync next Friday.

mira: +1. Anything else?

ryan: Not from perf side. Will ping when graphs are in. :thumbsup:

toni: will open issue in 30m.

ash: PR for prompt pack by EoD Tuesday.

elaine: Thanks team. Closing thread for now — will repost update in #eng-ml when board is updated. :eyes:
